wizard.title: Create New Task
wizard.description: Describe what you want to build. The AI will analyze your request and create a detailed specification.
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior. Type @ to reference files.
wizard.descriptionHint: Files and images can be copy/pasted or dragged & dropped into the description.
wizard.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from description
wizard.titleHint: A short, descriptive title will be generated automatically if left empty.
wizard.classificationHint: These labels help organize and prioritize tasks. They're optional but useful for filtering.
wizard.requireReviewHint: When enabled, you'll be prompted to review the spec and implementation plan before the coding phase begins. This allows you to approve, request changes, or provide feedback.
wizard.baseBranchHint: Override the branch this task's worktree will be created from. Leave empty to use the project's configured default branch.
wizard.errorCreateFailed: Failed to create task. Please try again.

edit.title: Edit Task
edit.description: Update task details including title, description, classification, images, and settings. Changes will be saved to the spec files.
edit.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior.
edit.descriptionHint: Tip: Paste screenshots directly with {{shortcut}} to add reference images.
edit.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from description
edit.titleHint: A short, descriptive title will be generated automatically if left empty.
edit.classificationHint: These labels help organize and prioritize tasks. They're optional but useful for filtering.
edit.referenceImagesHint: Attach screenshots, mockups, or diagrams to provide visual context for the AI.
edit.requireReviewHint: When enabled, you'll be prompted to review the spec and implementation plan before the coding phase begins. This allows you to approve, request changes, or provide feedback.
edit.errorSaveFailed: Failed to update task. Please try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Task
deleteDialog.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete
deleteDialog.warningMessage: This action cannot be undone. All task files, including the spec, implementation plan, and any generated code will be permanently deleted from the project.

discardDialog.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to discard all changes for
discardDialog.warningMessage: This will permanently delete the isolated workspace and all uncommitted changes. The task will be moved back to Planning status.
